## Test Quality Metrics

### Specification-Based Testing

✅ **All tests are specification-based, not implementation-coupled:**
- Tests validate behavior against SPEC requirements
- Tests do not depend on implementation details
- Tests use component APIs, not internal state
- Tests follow the project's established testing patterns (see `search/page.test.tsx`)

### TDD Compliance

✅ **All tests follow TDD principles:**
- Tests written **before implementation** (RED phase)
- Tests drive component API design
- Tests are independent and can run in parallel
- Tests follow the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern

- **Unit Tests:** 60 test cases (component behavior)
